brief: make a website for my friend's cafe called Brew Lab in Bengaluru, with the menu, timings, where it is, a photo gallery and some stories about where their coffee comes from
outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.

asked: What is the cafe's full address, and what are its opening hours (including any days it is closed)? A phone number too, if they want one shown.
Do you have the menu with prices?
Do you have photos of the cafe, the food and the drinks for the gallery?
What do you know about where their coffee comes from (farm or estate names, regions, the people who grow it)?
questions_to_user.answer:
Address: 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038. Open 8am to 10pm every day, no closed days. Phone: +91 80 4000 2468.
Menu: Espresso ₹120, Cappuccino ₹180, Cold brew ₹200, Pour-over ₹220, Croissant ₹150, Banana bread ₹130.
Photos: not yet, leave empty photo spots to fill in later.
Coffee stories: Ratnagiri Estate in Chikmagalur grows shade-grown coffee; Kerehaklu in Chikmagalur grows coffee alongside pepper and cardamom; Baarbara Estate in Coorg hand-picks only ripe cherries.

done_when.criterion: The page title and main heading say Brew Lab, and the text mentions Bengaluru
A menu section lists exactly these items and prices: Espresso ₹120, Cappuccino ₹180, Cold brew ₹200, Pour-over ₹220, Croissant ₹150, Banana bread ₹130
A timings section says the cafe is open 8am to 10pm every day and has no closed days
A location section shows the address 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038, the phone number +91 80 4000 2468 as a tap-to-call link, and a directions link built from the address
A gallery section has at least 6 empty, labelled photo spots (cafe, food, drinks) ready to be filled in later

A coffee stories section has three stories: Ratnagiri Estate (Chikmagalur, shade-grown coffee), Kerehaklu (Chikmagalur, coffee grown alongside pepper and cardamom) and Baarbara Estate (Coorg, only ripe cherries hand-picked)
A navigation menu links to the menu, timings, location, gallery and stories sections, and every in-page link points to an element that exists
The layout has no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px widths and the file has no JavaScript errors
